incoming_learnings: Distinguish complete sentry geometry from executable potion preparation. A hypothetical protected chest route does not make flammable entry flooring a safe unknown-potion bank. Preserve unidentified colors, inventory protection and mandatory pickup until a preparation transaction is actually admitted.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health when mandatory preparation exhausted. Decision 262 (selection 740, accepted transition 741) entered the sentry doorway; decision 263 (743–745) stopped without recovery or descent. Earlier mapping at decision 108 (304–306) exposed terrain without surveying it. The sentry geometry helper treated mapped but unobserved interior and perimeter cells as a complete enclosure, suppressing the existing safe observation prerequisite while no protected reward trip was established. Offline bookkeeping reconstruction matches all 263 earlier selections and reproduces the original blocker. The focused correction requires observed enclosure geometry; the same terminal input then selects ordinary-floor reconnaissance, not drinking or descent. The new regression fails by assertion on original source and passes on the candidate; the full suite passes 2,154 tests with four skips. This establishes an admitted observation step, not chest discovery, potion safety, collection or survival.
review.learnings: Mapped terrain is not a completed sentry survey. Reobserve missing enclosure cells from admitted ordinary ground before exhausting preparation. Keep unknown potion identities, inventory protection, fresh arrival checks and mandatory progression pickup intact; choosing reconnaissance does not prove retrieval.
